attestation: I read AGENTS.md §1 for orientation and the permitted Slice 82 briefs, stayed within the reading restrictions, and used only the prescribed command to inspect stylesheet literals. I saved no friction note and started no daemon. I surveyed native-resolution regions of all 194 matrix first screens, all 492 listed scroll frames and all 20 runtime frames, then opened the relevant full frames and supporting accessibility trees or layout records for comparisons that needed confirmation. The desktop scroll frames show the Project details and Add workstream dialogs even though the corresponding light 1440px first screens show Kitchen without them.
